solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Talk about a long story!

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for talk is read backwards

parts.note: to gas is to chatter idly

explanation.surface: An exasperated listener complains that someone's chat has gone on far too long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Talk' looks like part of the definition, but it is wordplay, and 'about' signals that its synonym is read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is an epic tale, often stretched over generations, so a lengthy narrative.

clue.text: Saints admitting sin after hesitation in acts of worship

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the saints' letters take the other pieces inside them

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for saints, S doubled

indicators.note: after puts the word for sin following the hesitation

parts.note: er is the sound of a speaker hesitating
a vice is a moral failing or sin

explanation.surface: Holy people confess wrongdoing after some faltering during church rituals.
explanation.definitionFit: Church services are gatherings for public worship, each one a ceremony of prayer.

clue.text: Meet without hesitation in OT location

indicators.note: without tells us the hesitation sound is dropped from the word for meet

parts.note: to meet is to assemble or gather
er is the sound of a speaker hesitating

explanation.surface: Gather in a biblical place, getting straight to it with no dithering.
explanation.walkthrough: Gath was a Philistine city in the Old Testament (OT), home of Goliath.
explanation.definitionFit: Gath was a Philistine city named in the Old Testament, Goliath's birthplace.

clue.text: A female repeatedly publicises romantic liaisons

indicators.note: repeatedly says the letter for female appears twice in a row

parts.note: to air a view is to make it public, so airs means publicises

explanation.surface: A woman keeps broadcasting her love life to anyone who will listen.
explanation.definitionFit: Affairs are love relationships, typically secret or illicit ones.

clue.text: Holy woman, a Bishop Elizabeth

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
Bess is a pet form of the name Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A list of churchy figures: a nun-like woman, a bishop and someone called Elizabeth.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbess heads a community of nuns, so a religious woman of rank.

clue.text: Supporting best performance, to be factually correct

parts.note: to be for something is to support it
the record is the best performance ever achieved in a sport

explanation.surface: A fan backing a record-breaking athlete insists on getting the facts right.
explanation.definitionFit: Said 'for the record', a statement is made officially so that the facts are accurately noted.

clue.text: One religious woman is performing harmoniously

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a nun is a woman in a religious order
a performer who is on is on stage

explanation.surface: A single nun is on stage, singing beautifully in tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting or singing together in agreement, voices matching perfectly.

clue.text: Part of London oh so naughty!

indicators.note: naughty means misbehaving, so the letters of the two little words are mischievously rearranged

explanation.surface: A district of the capital is described with a wink as rather wicked.
explanation.walkthrough: SOHO is a central London district famous for nightlife and once for its seedier side, which makes 'naughty' doubly apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Soho is a district of the West End in central London.

clue.text: Attire for important woman at the match

definitions.text: Attire for important woman at the match

parts.words: Attire for important woman at the match
parts.note: the match sounds like a sporting fixture, but here it is a marriage, and the important woman is the bride

explanation.surface: A spectator chooses her outfit for a big game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' wants to be a sports fixture; it is a marriage, the 'important woman' being the bride.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride wears this gown at her marriage ceremony, where she is the central figure.

clue.text: Nasty old boy turning violent in old constituency

parts.note: rotten means nasty or unpleasant

indicators.note: turning means the two letters for old boy are read backwards

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
rough means violent, as in rough treatment

explanation.surface: A nasty former pupil has turned violent, in an old electoral district.
explanation.walkthrough: A rotten borough was a pre-1832 English parliamentary seat with hardly any voters, controlled by a patron.
explanation.definitionFit: Such boroughs elected MPs despite tiny electorates until the Reform Act of 1832 abolished them.

clue.text: Speak rudely to underworld god

definitions.meaning: to insult or disrespect them, here in its single-s spelling
The Roman god of the underworld, equivalent to Pluto

explanation.definitionFit: Slang 'dis' means to insult, and Dis Pater was the Roman lord of the dead.

clue.text: My American soldier's dog

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like 'my!'
a GI is a US soldier

explanation.surface: An exclamation at a US soldier's pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' is an exclamation here, not a possessive; COR is the British equivalent.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a short-legged Welsh breed, famous as royal pets.

clue.text: Way to get around hindrance in game

indicators.note: to get around means the word for way surrounds the word for hindrance

parts.note: a route is a way to go somewhere
a let is an obstacle, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A way to bypass an obstacle in some contest.
explanation.walkthrough: LET meaning hindrance survives in the legal phrase 'without let or hindrance' and as a tennis term.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is a casino gambling contest played with a spinning wheel and ball.

clue.text: Comes forward to show what climber must face?

definitions.meaning: to step up is to volunteer or come forward
someone ascending a staircase faces stairs going upward

explanation.definitionFit: Stepping up means volunteering; literally, ascending stairs means facing treads rising ahead.

clue.text: Old man sheltered and legally protected

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, one's old man
tented means covered by a tent, so sheltered

explanation.surface: Father camped under canvas and secured the rights to his invention.
explanation.definitionFit: An invention with a patent is protected by law from copying.

clue.text: Illegal trader avoiding jail finally becomes more complacent

indicators.note: avoiding says a letter is left out of the word for illegal trader

parts.note: a smuggler trades in contraband illegally

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word jail

explanation.surface: A contraband dealer who escapes prison grows ever more self-satisfied.
explanation.definitionFit: Smugger is the comparative of smug, meaning more self-satisfied.

clue.text: Modern musician's back, turning up with two pianos included

indicators.note: included means the two piano letters go inside the reversed word
turning up in a down entry means the word for back is read from bottom to top

parts.note: rear means the back
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly, so two of them give PP

explanation.surface: A contemporary performer's backside is shown, with a pair of pianos onstage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses the word for back, as suits a down entry, and 'included' puts the pianos inside it; P is the musical marking piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapper performs hip-hop, a contemporary musical genre.

clue.text: Artist offering some modern stuff

indicators.note: offering some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A painter is producing a bit of contemporary work.
explanation.walkthrough: Max Ernst was a German-born Dada and Surrealist painter, so 'modern' is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a leading Surrealist painter of the twentieth century.

clue.text: A Catholic circle needs more than one

parts.note: RC is the abbreviation for Roman Catholic

explanation.surface: A church group seems to want more than a single member.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: a circle is made of several curved segments, so it needs more than one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Any curved section of a circle's circumference is one of these, and several are needed to complete it.

clue.text: Something advantageous and ritzy almost

indicators.note: almost means the word for ritzy is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: ritzy means luxurious or plush

explanation.surface: A benefit that is nearly luxurious.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is a positive feature or benefit, the opposite of a minus.

clue.text: Sign up to be sea captain

indicators.note: up in a down entry means the word for sign is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an omen is a sign of things to come

explanation.surface: Enrol to become a ship's master.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign up' looks like enlisting; 'up' is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Captain Nemo commands the submarine Nautilus in Jules Verne's novels.

clue.text: Comment from appreciative tenant correctly expressed

definitions.meaning: a happy renter might praise the landlord, the one who lets the property, as flawless
word for word accurate, with nothing wrong

explanation.definitionFit: Word-perfect wording is accurate in every detail; a happy renter calls their landlord, one who lets, flawless.

clue.text: First half of series about writers, one writer in particular

indicators.note: about means the half-word goes around the word for writers
first half of takes the opening three letters of the six-letter word series

parts.note: pens are writing implements, things that write

explanation.surface: The opening part of a series concerning authors focuses on a single author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writers' are pens, not people; Edmund Spenser wrote The Faerie Queene.
explanation.definitionFit: Edmund Spenser was the Elizabethan poet who wrote The Faerie Queene.

clue.text: Gee — ancient and precious stuff

parts.note: gee is the spoken name of the letter G
old means ancient

explanation.surface: An exclamation of wonder at some valuable antique treasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold is a valuable metal, the classic precious material.
